simulation.name: simulation
simulation.description: A decision problem over a forward model: an action is a params injection, a transition one step of the model, the reward another partition.

inline.name: inline
inline.description: InlineExecution runs the simulation entirely on the calling goroutine: no worker goroutines, no channel handshakes and no WaitGroup barrier.

persistent_worker.name: persistent_worker
persistent_worker.description: PersistentWorkerExecution runs the simulation with one long-lived goroutine per partition rather than spawning a fresh goroutine per partition per phase per step.

spawn_per_step.name: spawn_per_step
spawn_per_step.description: SpawnPerStepExecution is the default execution strategy: each step spawns one goroutine per partition for the iteration phase and again for the update phase, synchronised by a two-phase barrier.

bernoulli_process.name: bernoulli_process
bernoulli_process.description: BernoulliProcessIteration emits 1/0 based on per-dimension success probs.

binomial_observation_process.name: binomial_observation_process
binomial_observation_process.description: BinomialObservationProcessIteration draws binomial counts for selected indices.

categorical_state_transition.name: categorical_state_transition
categorical_state_transition.description: CategoricalStateTransitionIteration is essentially a state machine which transitions between states according to the event rate parameters.

compound_poisson_process.name: compound_poisson_process
compound_poisson_process.description: CompoundPoissonProcessIteration steps a compound Poisson process.

constant_values.name: constant_values
constant_values.description: ConstantValuesIteration leaves initial state values unchanged over time.

copy_values.name: copy_values
copy_values.description: CopyValuesIteration copies selected values from other partitions' latest states into its own state.

cox_process.name: cox_process
cox_process.description: CoxProcessIteration defines an iteration for a Cox process.

cumulative.name: cumulative
cumulative.description: CumulativeIteration accumulates a provided iteration's outputs over time.

cumulative_time.name: cumulative_time
cumulative_time.description: CumulativeTimeIteration outputs the cumulative simulation time.

data_comparison.name: data_comparison
data_comparison.description: DataComparisonIteration allows for any log-likelihood to be used as a comparison distribution between data values, a mean vector and covariance matrix.

data_comparison_gradient.name: data_comparison_gradient
data_comparison_gradient.description: DataComparisonGradientIteration allows for any log-likelihood gradient to be used in computing the overall comparison distribution gradient.

choices.name: mean_gradient
choices.description: MeanGradientFunc computes the gradient with respect to the mean directly.

data_generation.name: data_generation
data_generation.description: DataGenerationIteration allows for any likelihood to be used as a data generation distribution based on a mean and covariance matrix.

discounted_cumulative.name: discounted_cumulative
discounted_cumulative.description: DiscountedCumulativeIteration accumulates a provided iteration's outputs over time with a discount factor applied to the previous accumulated state.

drift_diffusion.name: drift_diffusion
drift_diffusion.description: DriftDiffusionIteration steps a general drift–diffusion SDE per dimension.

drift_jump_diffusion.name: drift_jump_diffusion
drift_jump_diffusion.description: DriftJumpDiffusionIteration steps a general drift–jump–diffusion process.

embedded_simulation_run.name: embedded_simulation_run
embedded_simulation_run.description: EmbeddedSimulationRunIteration runs a nested simulation to termination at each outer step.

ensemble_kalman_filter.name: ensemble_kalman_filter
ensemble_kalman_filter.description: EnsembleKalmanFilterIteration assimilates observations into a forecast ensemble with the stochastic Ensemble Kalman Filter.

expression.name: expression
expression.description: ExpressionIteration is a declarative Iteration: the per-step update is given as string expressions rather than as Go, so a whole partition can be specified as data (and hence from YAML, or by an agent) with no compilation step.

from_history.name: from_history
from_history.description: FromHistoryIteration streams data from an in-memory StateHistory.

from_input.name: from_input
from_input.description: unboundInputIteration is what {type: from_input} resolves to at load: a placeholder for the input's rows, which are read when a run starts.

from_storage.name: from_storage
from_storage.description: FromStorageIteration streams data from an in-memory [][]float64.

geometric_brownian_motion.name: geometric_brownian_motion
geometric_brownian_motion.description: GeometricBrownianMotionIteration steps a multiplicative (geometric) Brownian motion per dimension.

gradient_descent.name: gradient_descent
gradient_descent.description: GradientDescentIteration performs a gradient-based parameter update.

hawkes_process.name: hawkes_process
hawkes_process.description: HawkesProcessIteration defines an iteration for a Hawkes process.

hawkes_process_intensity.name: hawkes_process_intensity
hawkes_process_intensity.description: HawkesProcessIntensityIteration an iteration for a Hawkes process self-exciting intensity function.

mcts_apply.name: mcts_apply
mcts_apply.description: ApplyIteration advances the environment by one ply per stochadex outer step using a best-action signal supplied either via params_from_upstream (within-step) OR via params_as_partitions (lagged read of an upstream partition's state-history row).

mcts_rollout.name: mcts_rollout
mcts_rollout.description: MCTSRolloutIteration runs one rollout per stochadex step.

mcts_tree.name: mcts_tree
mcts_tree.description: MCTSTreeIteration runs the (selection + expansion + backup) phase of a UCT MCTS search as a stochadex iteration.

ornstein_uhlenbeck.name: ornstein_uhlenbeck
ornstein_uhlenbeck.description: OrnsteinUhlenbeckIteration steps an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck mean-reverting process per dimension using an Euler–Maruyama discretisation.

ornstein_uhlenbeck_exact_gaussian.name: ornstein_uhlenbeck_exact_gaussian
ornstein_uhlenbeck_exact_gaussian.description: OrnsteinUhlenbeckExactGaussianIteration advances each dimension with the exact conditional Gaussian transition for an OU process on the current timestep increment (independent across dimensions).

param_values.name: param_values
param_values.description: ParamValuesIteration writes the float param values under "param_values" directly to the state.

poisson_process.name: poisson_process
poisson_process.description: PoissonProcessIteration implements a Poisson counting process for event simulation.

posterior_covariance.name: posterior_covariance
posterior_covariance.description: PosteriorCovarianceIteration updates an estimate of the covariance matrix of the posterior distribution over params using log-likelihood and param values given in the state history of other partitions, and a mean vector.

posterior_log_normalisation.name: posterior_log_normalisation
posterior_log_normalisation.description: PosteriorLogNormalisationIteration updates the cumulative normalisation of the posterior distribution over params using log-likelihood values given in the state history of other partitions as well as a specified past discounting factor.

posterior_mean.name: posterior_mean
posterior_mean.description: PosteriorMeanIteration updates an estimate of the mean of the posterior distribution over params using log-likelihood and param values given in the state history of other partitions.

choices.name: mean
choices.description: MeanTransform returns the values needed to compute the mean.

choices.name: variance
choices.description: VarianceTransform returns the values needed to compute the variance.

replicated_simulation_run.name: replicated_simulation_run
replicated_simulation_run.description: ReplicatedSimulationRunIteration states a model once, runs it once per replica at every step, and outputs each replica's final row of one partition.

scalar_regression_stats.name: scalar_regression_stats
scalar_regression_stats.description: ScalarRegressionStatsIteration maintains OLS-relevant sufficient statistics for scalar y on scalar x, optionally with intercept, and writes closed-form estimates each step.

smc_posterior.name: smc_posterior
smc_posterior.description: SMCPosteriorIteration computes importance-weighted posterior statistics from particle log-likelihoods and parameters received via params_from_upstream channels.

smc_proposal.name: smc_proposal
smc_proposal.description: SMCProposalIteration generates N particle proposals at each step.

values_changing_events.name: values_changing_events
values_changing_events.description: ValuesChangingEventsIteration calls and outputs from an iteration in the map keyed by an event.

values_collection.name: values_collection
values_collection.description: ValuesCollectionIteration maintains a fixed-width rolling collection of value vectors.

choices.name: next_non_empty
choices.description: NextNonEmptyPopIndexFunction scans the rolling collection for the next occupied slot (index > 0) and returns its index for popping.

choices.name: other_partition
choices.description: OtherPartitionPushFunction collects the latest values from another partition to push into the collection, subject to empty_value.

choices.name: param_values
choices.description: ParamValuesPushFunction reads the next values directly from params under "next_values_push", subject to empty_value.

choices.name: pop_from_other
choices.description: PopFromOtherCollectionPushFunction pulls the current popped values from another collection-like partition and uses them as the next values to push.

values_function.name: values_function
values_function.description: ValuesFunctionIteration provides a flexible way to compute derived values from simulation state and parameters using user-defined functions.

choices.name: params_event
choices.description: ParamsEventFunction emits an event value from the "event" params.

choices.name: partition_event
choices.description: PartitionEventFunction emits an event value from the latest state of another partition.

choices.name: sum
choices.description: SumReduce reduces a map of equally sized vectors by summing them element-wise into a single output vector.

choices.name: params
choices.description: ParamsTransform is a convenience transform that returns the current params map.

values_function_cumulative_mean.name: values_function_cumulative_mean
values_function_cumulative_mean.description: ValuesFunctionCumulativeMeanIteration is the running mean of a function's values over every row of the data it reads: the data partition's initial row and each step's row after it, all weighted equally.

choices.name: data_values
choices.description: DataValuesFunction returns values from "data_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: data_values_variance
choices.description: DataValuesVarianceFunction returns per-index squared deviations from the provided "mean" for "data_values_partition".

choices.name: other_values
choices.description: OtherValuesFunction returns values from "other_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: past_discounted_data_values
choices.description: PastDiscountedDataValuesFunction reads from "data_values_partition" and applies an exponential discount factor raised to the history depth index.

choices.name: past_discounted_other_values
choices.description: PastDiscountedOtherValuesFunction mirrors PastDiscountedDataValuesFunction for "other_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: unit_value
choices.description: UnitValueFunction returns [1].

values_function_vector_covariance.name: values_function_vector_covariance
values_function_vector_covariance.description: ValuesFunctionVectorCovarianceIteration computes a kernel-weighted rolling covariance of a function over historical values and times.

choices.name: data_values
choices.description: DataValuesFunction returns values from "data_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: data_values_variance
choices.description: DataValuesVarianceFunction returns per-index squared deviations from the provided "mean" for "data_values_partition".

choices.name: other_values
choices.description: OtherValuesFunction returns values from "other_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: past_discounted_data_values
choices.description: PastDiscountedDataValuesFunction reads from "data_values_partition" and applies an exponential discount factor raised to the history depth index.

choices.name: past_discounted_other_values
choices.description: PastDiscountedOtherValuesFunction mirrors PastDiscountedDataValuesFunction for "other_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: unit_value
choices.description: UnitValueFunction returns [1].

values_function_vector_mean.name: values_function_vector_mean
values_function_vector_mean.description: ValuesFunctionVectorMeanIteration computes a kernel-weighted rolling mean of a function over historical values and times.

choices.name: data_values
choices.description: DataValuesFunction returns values from "data_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: data_values_variance
choices.description: DataValuesVarianceFunction returns per-index squared deviations from the provided "mean" for "data_values_partition".

choices.name: other_values
choices.description: OtherValuesFunction returns values from "other_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: past_discounted_data_values
choices.description: PastDiscountedDataValuesFunction reads from "data_values_partition" and applies an exponential discount factor raised to the history depth index.

choices.name: past_discounted_other_values
choices.description: PastDiscountedOtherValuesFunction mirrors PastDiscountedDataValuesFunction for "other_values_partition", optionally subselecting indices.

choices.name: unit_value
choices.description: UnitValueFunction returns [1].

values_grouped_aggregation.name: values_grouped_aggregation
values_grouped_aggregation.description: ValuesGroupedAggregationIteration collects historical values and weights into grouping buckets (defined by tupled grouping series) and applies a caller-provided aggregation per bucket.

choices.name: count
choices.description: CountAggregation outputs, per group, the sum of weights (i.e., a count when weights are all 1).

choices.name: max
choices.description: MaxAggregation computes the maximum of weighted values per group.

choices.name: mean
choices.description: MeanAggregation computes the weighted mean of values per group.

choices.name: min
choices.description: MinAggregation computes the minimum of weighted values per group.

choices.name: sum
choices.description: SumAggregation computes the weighted sum of values per group.

values_sorted_collection_covariance.name: values_sorted_collection_covariance
values_sorted_collection_covariance.description: ValuesSortedCollectionCovarianceIteration computes a weighted covariance matrix of the top entries in a sorted collection around a provided mean, blended with its own previous state via a learning rate.

values_sorted_collection_mean.name: values_sorted_collection_mean
values_sorted_collection_mean.description: ValuesSortedCollectionMeanIteration computes a weighted mean of the top entries in a sorted collection, blended with its own previous state via a learning rate.

values_sorting_collection.name: values_sorting_collection
values_sorting_collection.description: ValuesSortingCollectionIteration maintains a sorted collection of entries.

choices.name: other_partitions
choices.description: OtherPartitionsPushAndSortFunction retrieves values from one partition and sorts by another partition's value.

choices.name: param_values
choices.description: ParamValuesPushAndSortFunction uses params for both values and sort key.

values_weighted_resampling.name: values_weighted_resampling
values_weighted_resampling.description: ValuesWeightedResamplingIteration resamples historical values from other partitions according to provided (optionally discounted) weights.

wiener_process.name: wiener_process
wiener_process.description: WienerProcessIteration implements a standard Wiener process (Brownian motion) for stochastic simulation.

gamma_jump.name: gamma_jump
gamma_jump.description: GammaJumpDistribution draws jump magnitudes from a gamma distribution.

binned.name: binned
binned.description: BinnedIntegrationKernel outputs piecewise-constant weights in time.

exponential.name: exponential
exponential.description: ExponentialIntegrationKernel applies exponential decay over time.

gaussian_state.name: gaussian_state
gaussian_state.description: GaussianStateIntegrationKernel implements a Gaussian state-distance kernel for weighting historical samples based on their distance from the current state.

instantaneous.name: instantaneous
instantaneous.description: InstantaneousIntegrationKernel returns 1.0 for the most recent sample and 0.0 otherwise.

product.name: product
product.description: ProductIntegrationKernel multiplies two kernels to form a composite weight.

t_distribution_state.name: t_distribution_state
t_distribution_state.description: TDistributionStateIntegrationKernel applies a multivariate t kernel using an input scale matrix and degrees of freedom.

beta.name: beta
beta.description: BetaLikelihoodDistribution implements a Beta distribution likelihood model for bounded continuous data analysis and parameter estimation.

gamma.name: gamma
gamma.description: GammaLikelihoodDistribution assumes the real data are well described by a gamma distribution, given the input mean and variance.

negative_binomial.name: negative_binomial
negative_binomial.description: NegativeBinomialLikelihoodDistribution assumes the real data are well described by a negative binomial distribution, given the input mean and variance.

normal.name: normal
normal.description: NormalLikelihoodDistribution models data with a multivariate normal.

poisson.name: poisson
poisson.description: PoissonLikelihoodDistribution models count data with a Poisson distribution.

t_distribution.name: t_distribution
t_distribution.description: TLikelihoodDistribution assumes the real data are well described by a Student's t-distribution, given the input degrees of freedom, mean and covariance matrix.

wishart.name: wishart
wishart.description: WishartLikelihoodDistribution assumes the real data are well described by a Wishart distribution, given the input degrees of freedom and scale matrix.

every_n_steps.name: every_n_steps
every_n_steps.description: EveryNStepsOutputCondition emits output once every N steps.

every_step.name: every_step
every_step.description: EveryStepOutputCondition calls the OutputFunction at every step.

final_step.name: final_step
final_step.description: FinalStepOutputCondition writes each partition's state once, as it stands when the run ends: the run's final step, or its initial state for a run of no steps.

only_given_partitions.name: only_given_partitions
only_given_partitions.description: OnlyGivenPartitionsOutputCondition emits output only for listed partitions.

json_log.name: json_log
json_log.description: JsonLogOutputFunction writes newline-delimited JSON log entries.

nil.name: nil
nil.description: NilOutputFunction outputs nothing from the simulation.

postgres.name: postgres
postgres.description: PostgresDb is a struct which can be configured to define interactions with a PostgresSQL database.

stdout.name: stdout
stdout.description: StdoutOutputFunction outputs the state to the terminal.

websocket.name: websocket
websocket.description: WebsocketPushOutputFunction streams outputs to a websocket server, acting as the client: the config names a URL (output_function: {type: websocket, url: ...}) and the run pushes to it.

half_normal.name: half_normal
half_normal.description: HalfNormalPrior is a half-normal distribution (x >= 0) with scale sigma.

log_normal.name: log_normal
log_normal.description: LogNormalPrior is a log-normal distribution: log(x) ~ N(mu, sigma^2).

truncated_normal.name: truncated_normal
truncated_normal.description: TruncatedNormalPrior is a normal distribution truncated to [Lo, Hi].

uniform.name: uniform
uniform.description: UniformPrior is a uniform distribution on [Lo, Hi].

input_exhausted.name: input_exhausted
input_exhausted.description: unboundInputExhausted is termination_condition {type: input_exhausted}: a step per row after the input's first, once bound.

exponential_distribution.name: exponential_distribution
exponential_distribution.description: ExponentialDistributionTimestepFunction draws dt from an exponential distribution parameterised by Mean and Seed.

from_history.name: from_history
from_history.description: FromHistoryTimestepFunction streams timesteps from an in-memory CumulativeTimestepsHistory.

from_input.name: from_input
from_input.description: unboundInputTimesteps is timestep_function {type: from_input}: the input's times, once bound.

from_storage.name: from_storage
from_storage.description: FromStorageTimestepFunction streams timesteps from an in-memory []float64.
